name: dsv-g007-monitor-policy
source: repo-owned structured logs, health checks, checked-in Prisma migration directory, Prisma migration table, and DSV audit tables

statusPolicy.ok: all required checks return ok and legacy_read/legacy_write are zero in the selected window
statusPolicy.unknown: one or more checks cannot be read without a critical finding
statusPolicy.critical: health/ready failure, pending/missing/failed/unexpected migration, invariant failure, or nonzero legacy_read/legacy_write

checks.name: migrations
checks.criticalWhen: any checked-in migration is missing from successful applied history, required latest migration 20260730170000_backfill_dsv_dispatch_groupings is absent, any row has finished_at IS NULL or rolled_back_at IS NOT NULL, or successful history contains a migration outside the 56-migration directory-derived chain

checks.name: canonical_duplicate_active_assignments
checks.criticalWhen: more than one active currentRouteVersionId exists for the same full canonical order identity

checks.name: recurring_active_seller_keys
checks.note: counts shopId/sellerOrderKey pairs that are active across multiple source-kind/service-date identities; recurring seller keys are permitted and are not assignment duplicates

checks.name: import_partial_apply_indicators
checks.criticalWhen: an applying or blocked import row has an apply receipt

checks.name: eta_input_route_version_mismatches
checks.criticalWhen: an active route plan stop has a non-null etaInputRouteVersionId that is missing or differs from that route plan's current RouteGroupingChildVersion, regardless of etaStatus

checks.name: legacy_usage
checks.source: structured request logs aggregated by scripts/dsv-g007-observation-report.sh
checks.note: canonical_assignment_command_alias is reported separately and does not count as legacy_write
